q1_issues.issue: "the Keepers" is capitalized mid-sentence (a named order/body), yet it is encoded as an ordinary common-noun group with no (Name …) atom, which the instruction set makes mandatory and non-optional for a proper noun.

q2_gaps: indicative 'if P, Q' conditional — the instruction set names the plain Implication form but gives no worked example, so nothing fixes how the antecedent clause's event and participants are variabilized, nor whether the consequent's per-occurrence Skolem event ties back to the antecedent (the During tie is specified only for 'every time / whenever')
notes: The (During (sk_yield $x) $x) link in the consequent is the 'every time / whenever' machinery applied to a bare 'if' conditional; no word in the text puts it there, though the construction is closely analogous. Reading 'in sea-water' as Location rather than Instrument is defensible under the where-test, and the compound decompositions (silken_thread, sea_water, mire_essence) follow the adjective-vs-noun-modifier line correctly.
